content: We have evaluated an extensive variation of MT models that rely only on in-domain parallel and monolingual data. However, the resulting BLEU scores for Ja INLINEFORM2 Ru and Ru INLINEFORM3 Ja tasks do not exceed 10 BLEU points, implying the inherent limitation of the in-domain data as well as the difficulty of these translation directions.
